meta.title: Experiment: enable multi-threaded rendering
meta.body_summary: Add multi-threaded rendering by parallelizing render_video_to_channel with a worker pool and making RenderSegment clonable in the rendering crate.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added worker pool parallelization to rendering; PR closed because upcoming Skia rewrite will require reimplementation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 118 changed lines across 3 files, this is a small edit. It is a targeted performance experiment for multi-threaded rendering, but was closed without merge because the maintainer indicated a future Skia rewrite will obsolete it.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer Brendonovich commented that the multi-threaded rendering will need to be reimplemented after the upcoming Skia rewrite, indicating the current implementation is not worth merging now.
review_details.performance_claim: Parallelize video rendering to improve throughput via worker pool multithreading.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer closed PR stating it will need reimplementation after Skia rewrite, not due to performance or correctness issues.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The PR was closed not due to technical issues but because a planned refactor (Skia rewrite) would make the implementation obsolete; this illustrates a process boundary where agent contributions may be invalidated by upcoming architectural changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body mentions cargo check fails due to missing screencapturekit dependency; no performance metrics or instructions.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merging; no regression handling needed.

core_change_summary.description: In crates/rendering/src/lib.rs, added rayon worker pool to render_video_to_channel, made RenderSegment clonable, and added num_cpus dependency in Cargo.toml.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add multithreaded rendering using worker pool.
Fix commit: handle JoinError from parallel processing.
